messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: POC success criteria & KPIs - recap and next steps

Thanks again for your time today, Samir 

great discussion. 

Recap / agreed objectives:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for customer support summarization + routing at Atlas Payments (post-call and email summarization).
- Success criteria (proposed):
  - Latency: p95 generation latency < 300ms for 1-2 sentence summaries (95th pct across sampled requests).
  - Throughput: sustained 200 requests/sec on typical batch traffic (99% availability during test windows).
  - Cost: effective cost/token (inference) <= $0.001/token with suggested batching/quantization config.
  - Quality: intent classification/summary accuracy >= 92% vs Atlas labels; ROUGE-L / embedding similarity >= 0.85 on hold-out eval set.

Proposed evaluation plan (2-week trial):
- Week 0 (this week): Data exchange and environment prep 

- Atlas provides ~5k representative examples + labels and access to sandbox endpoint (if needed).
- Week 1: Deploy trial instance (dedicated capacity), run ingestion and evaluation harness, collect latency/throughput metrics and sample outputs.
- Week 2: Iterate on prompts/config, run final evaluation and present results + recommendations.

Ownership:
- Atlas: provide sample dataset, evaluation labels, procurement for dedicated instance approval.
- Redwood (Marissa): trial owner 

deploy instance, run eval harness, produce KPI dashboard and final readout.
- Jordan: primary sales contact and escalation for timeline/scope.

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Samir: share sample dataset and any compliance constraints (PII redaction guidance) 

- target: EOD Friday.
2) Marissa: prepare trial environment blueprint and quote (CC'd).
3) Jordan: schedule kickoff and send PO/procurement template if needed.

Attachments: I attached a short POC plan with milestones and measurement details (20270715-atlas-poc-plan.xlsx).

Looking forward to getting this started 

- I propose a 30-min kickoff on Monday to align owners.

Best,
Jordan
